283352177.description:
Arizona Petrified Wood
Polished Fossil Slab Display Specimen
Late Triassic Period
Originating from northeastern Arizona, this petrified wood slab dates to the Late Triassic period, over 200 million years ago. Silica replaced buried wood fibers while iron and manganese oxides imparted rich tones of brick red, amber, and black. The piece showcases fine fossilization with a polished face and authentic rough outer bark.
Polished display face highlighting mineral banding and grain structure
Natural rough rind preserving the exterior tree bark texture
Flat cut bottom with four protective cork pads for upright display
Includes educational informational card on Arizona petrified wood
Dimensions: 7.2" H x 6.6" W x 2.2" D; Weight: 1.65 lbs
Condition:
Polished surface is smooth with natural internal micro-fissures inherent to fossilized stone. Natural rough edges are intact. Base is cut flat and stands upright securely; partial label residue on underside. Information card has handling creases.

282968922.description:
Natural Amethyst Crystal Cluster
Geode Specimen on Display Stand
Amethyst Quartz & Wood Base, 6 x 6 Inches
This natural amethyst geode specimen features a cavity of well-formed purple quartz crystal terminations set against its natural rock matrix. Mounted on a fitted beveled wooden display base with a deep mahogany finish, this piece highlights the contrast between the rough natural exterior and the crystalline interior. Amethyst has long been valued both as an ornamental mineral specimen and for decorative display.
Features a natural cluster of deep purple to lavender amethyst crystal points
Natural raw rock matrix backing securely mounted to wooden plinth
Beveled wooden display base with rich dark gloss finish
Measures approximately 6 inches in height by 6 inches in width
Condition:
The crystal points are well-preserved with natural growth features, inclusions, and varying tip terminations typical of geological specimens. Natural rough rock matrix on the reverse is solid and stable. The wooden base is structurally sound and stands level with light surface wear, minor edge marks, and handwritten inventory numbers on the unfinished underside.
Thank you for all of your support!
